gold.user: As a conference organizer, I want to retrieve a list of all recordings for a specific conference so that I can review the discussions and share them with participants.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON array of recordings, including details such as the recording SID, duration, and date created.

gold.user: As a conference administrator, I need to update the metadata of a specific recording to include additional notes and change its status to 'reviewed'.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with the updated metadata and return a confirmation of the update along with the updated recording details.

gold.user: As a participant, I want to fetch a specific recording of a conference so that I can listen to the part I missed.
gold.ideal: The API should return the details of the requested recording, including a URL to access the audio file and metadata such as duration and date.

gold.user: As a conference manager, I need to delete a specific recording that is no longer needed to keep our storage organized and compliant with data retention policies.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the recording and return a success message indicating that the recording has been removed.
